versions.changelog:
Initial release of Trending Meme Encyclopedia Skill.

- Enables users to track and analyze trending memes (热梗/迷因) from B站 (bilibili), 抖音, 微博, 小红书, and 知乎.
- Retrieves meme origins, explains meanings, and collects related video materials.
- Supports structured meme encyclopedia creation for content research, creativity, and discussion tracking.
- Customizable output: time range, platform, meme type, quantity, and output format.
- Provides detailed templates and workflow to trace, explain, and document memes in Markdown and other formats.
